FEAT-2-S139.title: Implement Core Specialty Mapping Pipeline
FEAT-2-S139.description: Implement the dual-path specialty identification pipeline combining regex-based extraction and vector similarity matching, including parallel execution and aggregation into normalized NUCC outputs.

FEAT-2-S140.title: Add Confidence Scoring and Deduplication Logic
FEAT-2-S140.description: Enhance specialty mapping results with confidence scoring, deduplication of overlapping NUCC codes, and aggregation of similar classifications into a final ranked output.

FEAT-2-S141.title: Validate Tool Router Integration for Specialty Queries
FEAT-2-S141.description: Ensure specialty identification is properly invoked through the tool_router with validated inputs, correct tool selection, and structured output passed back into the agent loop.

FEAT-2-S142.title: Handle Ambiguous and Multi-Specialty Inputs
FEAT-2-S142.description: Implement logic to support ambiguous queries and multi-specialty inputs, returning multiple NUCC codes with appropriate ranking and fallback behavior when confidence is low.

FEAT-2-S143.title: Integration Test: End-to-End Specialty to Provider Flow
FEAT-2-S143.description: Create integration tests validating that user input is correctly mapped to NUCC codes and drives provider search results through the full pipeline (facade → service → provider search).
